name: rendering_settings_from_blank
description: RSX: the Render tools' Rendering settings tab, from nothing. From a Blank project, the tab reads the root's rendering section; Add define opens a row, the name is typed and Return commits it, which sends one edit_rendering_keys and the root holds the define (get_render_documents says so). Edit > Undo Render Edit takes it back -- the render edit history names it Set shader_defines -- and the root no longer holds it.
